integrity: The threshold criterion was derived directly from the source’s displayed closed form for the basic reproduction number. The witness transmission rates were reconstructed from the paper’s primitive bite/preference parametrization, and all equilibrium residuals were checked with exact rational arithmetic. Exact-title, DOI, threshold-expression, correction/erratum, semantic database, and local-ledger searches found no covering correction or prior claim. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result corrects the source-specific algebraic equivalence used in Appendix A and supplies one exact admissible endemic witness in the omitted branch. It does not claim that the published formula for the basic reproduction number is wrong, does not prove global dynamics or uniqueness of endemic equilibria, and does not assess the seasonal data-fitting conclusions.
title: The Oropouche threshold criterion has a missing supercritical branch
